observed_startup_defect.effect: The ordinary Diary opened on the actual calendar date with zero appointments instead of the populated authored-synthetic reference date.

accepted_findings.basis: Five tasks were rated Reception One better; the combined availability-to-proposal flow was specifically described as impressive; Bureau workflow was supported.
The full-window projection replaced the Diary, used excessive empty space and made return affordances unclear.
The initial Diary ignored the frozen reference date and required a manual date correction.
Wording was repeatedly described as technical or legalistic and should become conversational.
Back-path and Diary-context-loss flags each occurred three times; Escape and the custom return control were not immediately discoverable.
The interaction worked technically but was described as bland and in need of restrained visual improvement.
Yuri explicitly rejected use of the word grid in the final user interface.

explicit_exclusions: No real patient, practitioner or practice data.
No appointment write, provider call or credential evidence.
